verdict.rationale: The Teams API, exposed through Microsoft Graph, shows explicit version labeling: the channel-post-messages docs link resources with `?view=graph-rest-1.0`, which indicates a versioned v1.0 API surface. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version lifecycle guarantees, so only the versioning half of the story has thin support. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation or breaking-change policy, an explicit version lifecycle or beta-vs-v1.0 stability guarantees, and independent corroboration.
